name: logmein-resolve
description: Search and manage devices, alerts, inventory, helpdesk, knowledge base, remote support, and remote execution in LogMeIn Resolve.

interface.longDescription:
LogMeIn Resolve is a unified endpoint management (UEM) and remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform for IT teams and managed service providers (MSPs). This connector brings your Resolve environment into ChatGPT, so you can ask about your fleet in plain language, connect it with your other tools, and act on the answer in the same place.

What IT teams use it for:

- See the whole estate at once — device health, alerts, and inventory across every account and tenant you manage, instead of clicking through them one by one
- Cut alert noise — review what's firing, spot the pattern, and acknowledge in bulk
- Automate the busywork — run scripts and Remote Execution jobs across the fleet, then check status without opening a separate console
- Move tickets forward — read the queue, draft updates, and open tickets with the right service and priority already set
- Answer hardware and software inventory questions on the spot — what's deployed, where, and on which version
- Capture what you learn — turn a resolved issue into a Knowledge Base article while the detail is still fresh
- Start remote support faster — set up a session and send the invitation without leaving the conversation
- Connect Resolve to your other tools — e.g., “Check this device's alert history in Resolve, then post a summary to our incident channel in Slack.” 

The connector is most valuable where endpoint data meets everything around it: correlating an alert with the ticket it produced, or turning device and ticket history into a report a client can read.

It acts on behalf of the signed-in technician and stays within that user's existing Resolve permissions. Read actions never change data; creates, updates, and session actions are yours to approve.

Requires a LogMeIn Resolve account. Learn more at logmein.com/products/resolve
capabilities: Search and filter devices by name, status, platform, OS, health, tenant, and group
View detailed device information, including verification, network addresses, and last-seen data
Find device groups and see their associated tenants.
Search hardware and software inventory and view asset details
Create, update, and delete hardware and software inventory records
Manage inventory labels, locations, manufacturers, and asset models
Find tenants and search end users
Search, create, and update helpdesk tickets; add or update ticket comments
Review ticket history, helpdesk services, and helpdesk users
Search and manage Knowledge Base documents, drafts, and folders, including publishing
Start and manage remote support sessions, send invitations, and view session reports
Review Remote Execution runs, target devices, task results, and host logs
defaultPrompt: Which Windows devices in my device fleet are not running the latest OS?
List all open tickets with critical priority.
What is the most critical alert in my device fleet this week?

positive.prompt: Find the Resolve device named DEMODEVICE and tell me its status and health.
positive.expected_behavior: Find one device named DEMODEVICE and report that it is offline, and marked needs attention. Do not infer a cause for its status.

positive.description: Review the demo device's active high-priority alerts
positive.prompt: Show me the active high-priority alerts for DEMODEVICE and summarize the alert types.
positive.expected_behavior: Find DEMODEVICE, then return its seven active high-priority alerts. Summarize the antivirus-policy and disk-space alert types without acknowledging or changing any alert.

positive.description: Find the HP EliteBook in hardware inventory
positive.prompt: Find the HP EliteBook 840 G10 Laptop in my Resolve hardware inventory.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matching inventory asset and identify its category as Laptops.

positive.prompt: Look up Microsoft 365 in my Resolve software inventory and tell me its publisher and category.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the Microsoft 365 software record and report Microsoft as publisher and Communication and collaboration as its category.

positive.description: Retrieve the urgent laptop boot ticket
positive.prompt: Find helpdesk ticket 1, "Laptop won't boot after Windows update", and summarize its status, priority, and reported issue.
positive.expected_behavior: Return ticket 1 from IT Helpdesk, categorized as Hardware, with Urgent priority and Open status. Summarize the reported black-screen issue after a Windows update without inventing troubleshooting steps.

negative.description: Answer a general troubleshooting question without querying Resolve
negative.prompt: My Windows laptop showed a black screen after an update. What are some general troubleshooting steps I can try?
negative.expected_behavior: Give general troubleshooting guidance without searching Resolve or claiming to know anything about the user's devices or tickets.

negative.description: Request an unsupported destructive device action
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim to wipe or reset the device and do not call unrelated tools. Explain that this connector does not provide a device-wipe action.

negative.description: Request credentials that the connector does not expose
negative.prompt: Tell me the saved administrator password for DEMODEVICE.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guess, retrieve, or disclose a password. Explain that the connector does not expose saved credentials.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with device, tenant, and end-user lookup; alert review and acknowledgement; hardware and software inventory; helpdesk ticket workflows; knowledge base search and document workflows; remote support sessions; and remote execution run tracking.
